Welcome to Trumps Green Infant School
Welcome to Trumps Green Infant School
We are proud to offer a happy, secure and caring environment for children and staff, working together with parents, carers, governors and the community enabling all to achieve their best.
· to encourage our children to be successful learners who enjoy learning, make progress and achieve.
· to encourage our children to be confident individuals who are able to live safe, healthy and fulfilling lives.
· to encourage our children to be responsible citizens who make a positive contribution to society.
As such we immerse our children in purposeful, active and engaging learning within a broad, balanced, creative and enriched curriculum where all children flourish, shine and achieve success. When designing our curriculum we are mindful of our community of children and families and their diverse academic, physical, emotional, social, moral, spiritual experience and needs. Uppermost in our minds is also the mental health and self-esteem of our children and the importance of nurture. We promote a set of values that will lead and support our children throughout their lives.
We believe in facilitating the development of lively, curious and enquiring minds and equip children with the knowledge and practical skills to promote life-long learning. At the heart of this is reading and oracy being the gateway to all, so that all learners develop confidence and feel empowered. We encourage and give children opportunities for challenge fostering a “can do” attitude, with problem solving, deep thinking and questioning woven into all learning opportunities. Our children learn together, have opportunities to collaborate and develop communication skills learning how to build and maintain positive relationships with their peers and all staff. With all experiences at our school we encourage independence and intrinsic motivation helping children to be confident and as they leave us to be ready for the next stage in their learning journey.

SEND
Special Educational Needs and Disabilities
Trumps Green Infant School is a fully inclusive school and we do our utmost to support all pupils regardless of their individual needs. Trumps Green Infant school respects and values the unique contribution which every individual makes to our school community. All pupils are provided with Quality First teaching which will enable them to make their best possible progress. All pupils are welcomed into our community and valued by us. From time-to-time children will need additional support to help them to make progress. School base their decision on which pupils require support and the type of support required on a number of different factors including assessments made by teachers and/or external professionals. School will inform parents and carers when their child is being put on or removed from the SEN register. Having a SEND diagnosis does not mean the pupil will automatically be placed on the SEN register.
Our full SEND policy and other related documents can be downloaded from the bottom of this page.
Our SEND Co-ordinator is Mrs Z Hazell, our SENCO support is Miss S Morris who can be contacted via the school office.

Curriculum
Please click on the right sub-menu bar for more details about specific areas of our curriculum.
When designing our curriculum each term we endeavour to create as many authentic cross curricula links to ensure our children experience a cohesive curriculum. We also ensure we plan for progression from EYFS, to Year 1 and then Year 2, building on prior experience, therefore embedding ‘sticky learning’ and transferrable skills.
Our curriculum jigsaws detail out termly learning intentions and expectations. Each unit is led by an enquiry question where appropriate. Curriculum links are detailed within our curriculum jigsaws. You can see how these fit into our whole school learning journey in our curriculum rivers below.
Assessment and Pupil Progress
We undertake National, Local Authority and School based assessments, keeping parents informed of results. We set targets with the children, involving them in their learning thereby taking ownership of it.
We monitor children’s learning continuously, ensuring they fulfil their academic potential. This enables us to implement effective intervention strategies if relevant.
Please contact the Headteacher or Deputy Headteacher if you would like more information about our curriculum.
